dialogues.jp: 「さて、何を食うかな」
dialogues.en: It's not because the fluorescent lights are broken.
dialogues.text: It's not because the fluorescent lights are broken.

dialogues.jp:
購買に向かいながら、今日の昼のメニューを考
える。
dialogues.en:
The room looks dim and dusty, but actually it's really
clean, except Koyomi-sensei's desk which is covered with
things.
dialogues.text:
The room looks dim and dusty, but actually it's really
clean, except Koyomi-sensei's desk which is covered with
things.

dialogues.jp: 定番の焼きそばパンは、外せないとして……。
dialogues.en:
For some reason, Koyomi-sensei's personal stuff like her
electronic pet are on the floor. The preparation room's like
Koyomi-sensei's private room.
dialogues.text:
For some reason, Koyomi-sensei's personal stuff like her
electronic pet are on the floor. The preparation room's like
Koyomi-sensei's private room.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「朝倉せんぱーい」
dialogues.en: "Huh?"
dialogues.text: "Huh?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「んっ？」
dialogues.en:
"At first, everybody thought Miharu was dead because there
were flowers on her desk, but then she came in to the
class."
dialogues.text:
"At first, everybody thought Miharu was dead because there
were flowers on her desk, but then she came in to the
class."

dialogues.jp:
少し俯きながら考えていた俺は、顔を上げて正
面を見る。
dialogues.en:
As soon as I said it, the blood drained from Koyomi-sensei's
face.
dialogues.text:
As soon as I said it, the blood drained from Koyomi-sensei's
face.

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「朝倉先輩、ニュースです。大ニュースです」
dialogues.en: "Wait a second......"
dialogues.text: "Wait a second......"

dialogues.jp:
前から走ってきた美春が、息を切らせて興奮気
味に話す。
dialogues.en:
She was looking there for a while, but soon she dropped her
shoulders, sighed and came back.
dialogues.text:
She was looking there for a while, but soon she dropped her
shoulders, sighed and came back.

dialogues.jp:
「息を整えるか、落ち着くかしないと窒息死す
　るぞ」
dialogues.en: "Who are you talking about?"
dialogues.text: "Who are you talking about?"

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「それどころじゃないですよ。出たんです、本
　当に出たんですよ」
dialogues.en: "Amakase."
dialogues.text: "Amakase."

dialogues.jp: 命の危険もかえりみず、話しつづける美春。
dialogues.en: "I don't know what to say."
dialogues.text: "I don't know what to say."

dialogues.jp: いったい何が出たというんだか……。
dialogues.en:
"Why have you changed the subject? Why are you talking about
robots?"
dialogues.text:
"Why have you changed the subject? Why are you talking about
robots?"

dialogues.jp: 「出たって、便秘でもしてたのか？」
dialogues.en: Koyomi-sensei's writhing in front of me.
dialogues.text: Koyomi-sensei's writhing in front of me.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「違います！　ヘンなこと言わないでください
　よ。そんなんじゃなくて、幽霊ですよ、幽霊」
dialogues.en: "Well, you know I'm studying mechanical engineering, right?"
dialogues.text: "Well, you know I'm studying mechanical engineering, right?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「ユウレイ？」
dialogues.en:
Amakase Research Institute is Miharu's father's institute.
He's famous in the robotics industry.
dialogues.text:
Amakase Research Institute is Miharu's father's institute.
He's famous in the robotics industry.

dialogues.jp:
何をさす言葉だか分からないといった感じで、
オウム返しに繰り返す。
dialogues.en:
"Does it seriously affect my life? Are they trying to
recruit me?"
dialogues.text:
"Does it seriously affect my life? Are they trying to
recruit me?"

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「そうです。幽霊です！」
dialogues.en:
"No, never. With your grades, you could be a test subject
but never be one of the researchers."
dialogues.text:
"No, never. With your grades, you could be a test subject
but never be one of the researchers."

dialogues.jp:
ビシィッ！　と人差し指を突き立てて、美春が
声高に言う。
dialogues.en:
Koyomi-sensei's eyes became bloodshot. That's not a good
sign. She's the kind of persons who wouldn't hesitate to
modify a human brain.
dialogues.text:
Koyomi-sensei's eyes became bloodshot. That's not a good
sign. She's the kind of persons who wouldn't hesitate to
modify a human brain.

dialogues.en:
"Stop changing the subject! I can't tell if you're talking
about Miharu or robots. What are you talking about?"
dialogues.text:
"Stop changing the subject! I can't tell if you're talking
about Miharu or robots. What are you talking about?"

dialogues.jp: 「美春、授業中寝てたのか？」
dialogues.en:
Koyomi-sensei pressed her half-smoked cigarette on the
ashtray and took out a new one.
dialogues.text:
Koyomi-sensei pressed her half-smoked cigarette on the
ashtray and took out a new one.

dialogues.jp:
ダメだぞ、授業はちゃんと受けなきゃ。俺みた
いになっても知らないぞ。
dialogues.en: "Yes, I do. I've seen them on TV."
dialogues.text: "Yes, I do. I've seen them on TV."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「違います」
dialogues.en:
"I don't mean a robot that looks and moves like a human. A
'human-like robot' means a robot almost the same as a
human."
dialogues.text:
"I don't mean a robot that looks and moves like a human. A
'human-like robot' means a robot almost the same as a
human."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「１組の子が昨日、女の子の声を聞いたんです
　よ」
dialogues.en: I answered her as I scratched my head.
dialogues.text: I answered her as I scratched my head.

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「女の子の声？」
dialogues.en: "The Amakase you saw this morning wasn't Amakase."
dialogues.text: "The Amakase you saw this morning wasn't Amakase."

dialogues.jp:
……って、学園なんだから、どこからでも女の
子の声なんて聞こえると思うが。
dialogues.en:
"She wasn't Miharu? I don't understand. You're not saying
Miharu's dead and that was Miharu's ghost, are you?"
dialogues.text:
"She wasn't Miharu? I don't understand. You're not saying
Miharu's dead and that was Miharu's ghost, are you?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「花子さんです」
dialogues.en: Fortunately, the Miharu I saw had legs and a shadow.
dialogues.text: Fortunately, the Miharu I saw had legs and a shadow.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「花子さん？」

はて、シンプルかつ、どこかで聞いた名前だな。
……同じ学年の女の子か？
dialogues.en: ---- The room went silent for a while, again.
dialogues.text: ---- The room went silent for a while, again.

dialogues.jp: （それとも後輩だったけかな？）
dialogues.en:
"I like Polylabor the best. It's a robot, but it's
categorized as a police special vehicle and looks real."
dialogues.text:
"I like Polylabor the best. It's a robot, but it's
categorized as a police special vehicle and looks real."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「トイレの花子さんです」
dialogues.en: "I'm serious."
dialogues.text: "I'm serious."

dialogues.en:
"In combined robots, I like the one that's fifteen bodies
combined......"
dialogues.text:
"In combined robots, I like the one that's fifteen bodies
combined......"

dialogues.jp: 「はぁっ？」
dialogues.en:
"Are you saying that the Miharu I saw this morning was a
robot?"
dialogues.text:
"Are you saying that the Miharu I saw this morning was a
robot?"

dialogues.jp: 思わず、正直な反応がでる。
dialogues.en:
"Wait a second! If what you said's true, then what happened
to the real Miharu?"
dialogues.text:
"Wait a second! If what you said's true, then what happened
to the real Miharu?"

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「あ〜ッ！　先輩信じてませんね」
dialogues.en:
"----It's true that she had an accident and was taken to
hospital."
dialogues.text:
"----It's true that she had an accident and was taken to
hospital."

dialogues.jp: 美春が目の前で頬を膨らませる。
dialogues.en: "What!?"
dialogues.text: "What!?"

dialogues.jp: 「いや、普通信じろって方が無理だろ」
dialogues.en: "No...... then, Miharu is......"
dialogues.text: "No...... then, Miharu is......"

dialogues.jp: そんな学園の七不思議的なネタ。
dialogues.en:
"No, thank you. That's disrespectful of Miharu's life. I'm
disappointed in you."
dialogues.text:
"No, thank you. That's disrespectful of Miharu's life. I'm
disappointed in you."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「じゃあ、来てください朝倉先輩。証拠を見せ
　ますから」
dialogues.en: "Asakura......"
dialogues.text: "Asakura......"

dialogues.jp: 美春が俺の手を掴んで、ひっぱる。
dialogues.en:
"When I...... and Nemu heard our friend was dead, how much
do you think we got hurt?"
dialogues.text:
"When I...... and Nemu heard our friend was dead, how much
do you think we got hurt?"

dialogues.jp: 「証拠って……どうやって？」

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「現場で張りこむんですよ。犯人は、必ず現場
　に戻ってきますから」
dialogues.en: "And that plan has already started."
dialogues.text: "And that plan has already started."

dialogues.en: That was a robot. I didn't notice at all.
dialogues.text: That was a robot. I didn't notice at all.

dialogues.jp: （幽霊って、犯人なのか？）
dialogues.en: Come to think of it, something was funny about her.
dialogues.text: Come to think of it, something was funny about her.

dialogues.en:
It's true that if somebody's with it, the robot's identity
is safe to a certain extent.
dialogues.text:
It's true that if somebody's with it, the robot's identity
is safe to a certain extent.

dialogues.en:
If its identity's revealed, the real Miharu in hospital may
become the subject of people's curiosity.
dialogues.text:
If its identity's revealed, the real Miharu in hospital may
become the subject of people's curiosity.

dialogues.jp: そこは当然だが｛・・・・・／女子トイレ｝だった。
dialogues.en:
Also, if the robot's so human like, it'll be a subject of
curiosity as well for sure.
dialogues.text:
Also, if the robot's so human like, it'll be a subject of
curiosity as well for sure.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「このトイレの一番奥の個室です、先輩」
dialogues.en:
"Some students have already seen Miharu this morning. So we
can't give an inch now."
dialogues.text:
"Some students have already seen Miharu this morning. So we
can't give an inch now."

dialogues.jp:
美春が、新米刑事のような顔つきで、真面目に
｛・・／現場｝の説明をする。
dialogues.en:
"If I refuse your proposal, you'll ask somebody else,
right?"
dialogues.text:
"If I refuse your proposal, you'll ask somebody else,
right?"

dialogues.jp: 一番奥の個室って……。
dialogues.en: "OK. I'll do it. I don't want anyone else doing this."
dialogues.text: "OK. I'll do it. I don't want anyone else doing this."

dialogues.jp: （俺にどうやってそこまで行けと？）
dialogues.en: She sounded like she was prepared to say that.
dialogues.text: She sounded like she was prepared to say that.

dialogues.jp: 学生が通り過ぎていく廊下で、立ち尽くす俺。
dialogues.en:
"But do you think it's all right? Won't people find out
she's a robot?"
dialogues.text:
"But do you think it's all right? Won't people find out
she's a robot?"

dialogues.jp: もしかして、俺を性犯罪者に仕立て上げる罠？
dialogues.en: She's right. I still can't believe it was a robot.
dialogues.text: She's right. I still can't believe it was a robot.

dialogues.jp:
まさか杉並あたりが裏で糸引いてるんじゃない
だろうな。
dialogues.en: Koyomi-sensei sneered.
dialogues.text: Koyomi-sensei sneered.

dialogues.jp: 思わず首謀者の姿を探して、周囲を見回す。
dialogues.en: A long stick of cigarette ash fell into the ashtray.
dialogues.text: A long stick of cigarette ash fell into the ashtray.

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「先輩、早く隠れないと見つかっちゃいますよ」
dialogues.en:
"Well then, come here again after school and I'll introduce
the robot... I mean, Amakase to you then."
dialogues.text:
"Well then, come here again after school and I'll introduce
the robot... I mean, Amakase to you then."

dialogues.jp:
俺の手を引きながら、美春が扉を押すと、ピン
ク色の壁が姿を現し、魅惑的な空間が目の前に
広がる。
dialogues.en:
But after tracing my memory from this morning, I still can't
believe that Miharu was a robot.
dialogues.text:
But after tracing my memory from this morning, I still can't
believe that Miharu was a robot.

dialogues.jp: 一歩、足を踏み出した俺は……。
dialogues.en:
I can't tell the difference between the robot and human
Miharu.
dialogues.text:
I can't tell the difference between the robot and human
Miharu.

dialogues.jp:
美春の首根っこを掴み、もと来た道を猛然と引
き返した。
dialogues.en:
I took the job, but can I handle it? I've no idea what it'll
be like.
dialogues.text:
I took the job, but can I handle it? I've no idea what it'll
be like.

dialogues.jp: ◆トイレの花子さん◆
dialogues.en: ◆When I got to the biology preparation room, Koyomi-sensei was all prepared and waiting for me.◆
dialogues.text: ◆When I got to the biology preparation room, Koyomi-sensei was all prepared and waiting for me.◆

dialogues.jp: 美春が大ニュースを持ってやって来た。
dialogues.en: "It's dim in here as usual."
dialogues.text: "It's dim in here as usual."

dialogues.jp:
女子トイレに“花子さん”とかって幽霊が出る
らしいが、俺はそこには入れないだろうが……。
dialogues.en: The lights are never on in this room.
dialogues.text: The lights are never on in this room.
